episode_row: 1am cron re-applied an already-graded result (streak 4 vs 2)

commits.subject: fix(check-results): skip when scheduler already resolved pick
commits.body:
The 1am check-results cron was double-counting the streak when the
scheduler had already updated it mid-game. Now skips with a message
when daily.result is already "hit" or "miss".

Bug caused streak to show 4 instead of correct 2 after April 4.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
